faq.q: How do I join the server?
faq.a: Join Discord first, read the rules, then use the Connect link on this portal (cfx.re/join code). You need licensed GTA V and FiveM installed.
ESX Legacy with ox_inventory, ox_target, ox_lib, Wasabi scripts for PD/EMS, and pyh job scripts for civilian work.

faq.q: How do I get a job?
faq.a: Visit job locations on the map (PD, EMS, mechanics) or use the ShadeRP Job Tablet for trucking, Gruppe 6, contacts, and boosting.
Paychecks every 15 minutes while on duty. Starting bank $15,000 and cash $750. Side jobs pay via reputation in pyh scripts.
Public info for players plus staff tools. Login with Discord to unlock panels based on your server roles.
Owner & lead developer runs the server and all custom setup. See the Team page for credits.

rules.title: Serious roleplay
rules.body: Stay in character at all times in public. No random deathmatch, cop baiting, or breaking character for OOC drama.

rules.title: Respect & maturity
rules.body: Treat players and staff with respect. Harassment, slurs, hate speech, or toxicity is zero tolerance.

rules.title: No cheating or exploits
rules.body: No mod menus, money glitches, duping, or bug abuse. EZAC and staff review logs.

rules.title: New Life Rule (NLR)
rules.body: After respawning you forget the events that led to your death. Do not return to the scene for revenge.

rules.title: Combat & initiation
rules.body: Give clear RP initiation before hostile actions. Value your life — do not fight unrealistic odds.

rules.title: Crime & police
rules.body: Crime must have RP reason and escalation. Cop baiting and unrealistic robberies are not allowed.

rules.title: Meta & powergaming
rules.body: No Discord/streams info in-game. No forcing outcomes other players cannot respond to.

rules.title: Microphone
rules.body: Working microphone required for most RP. Push-to-talk recommended.

updatePasses.title: 18 June 2026 · Enhancement Pass v10
updatePasses.body:
# ShadeRP — Server Update Log

**18 June 2026 · Enhancement Pass v10**

---

## Portal ↔ Server interconnect

| Change | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **portal.lua** | SSOT for website URL, CFX join code, connect info |
| **tuff-loading** | Portal button enabled — synced via `Apply-PortalLinks.ps1` |
| **gen_pausev2** | Portal announcement added |
| **Build-DashboardData** | Exports portal + connect to cloud sync |
| **Connect panel** | Live CFX link, portal URL, Discord from sync |
| **Deploy guide** | `tools/shaderp-dashboard/DEPLOY-QUICKSTART.md` |
| **One-shot sync** | `Sync-PortalToRender.ps1` |

After Render deploy, edit `shade-config/config/portal.lua` → run `Sync-PortalToRender.ps1`.

---

**18 June 2026 · Enhancement Pass v9**

---

## ShadeRP Portal v2 — Render + Discord + Analytics

Full-stack community portal replacing the static dashboard.

| Feature | Detail |
|---------|--------|
| **Hosting** | Node/Express — deploy to [Render](https://render.com) via `render.yaml` |
| **Theme** | Dark-only UI (`#06080c` base, cyan accent) |
| **Auth** | Discord OAuth2 + guild role sync |
| **Roles** | guest → member → moderator → staff → developer → admin → owner |
| **Analytics** | Page views, logins, panel tracking, Chart.js graphs (staff+) |
| **Public** | Home, About, Jobs, Connect, Updates (no login) |
| **Sync** | `Push-DashboardToRender.ps1` uploads server config to cloud |

**Setup guide:** `tools/shaderp-dashboard/RENDER-SETUP.md`

**Local:**
```
cd tools/shaderp-dashboard
copy .env.example .env
npm start
```

---

**18 June 2026 · Enhancement Pass v8**

---

## Overview

New **ShadeRP Control Panel** — a local admin website that syncs from your live server configs. Also added an official **ShadeRP logo** for Discord, dashboard, and branding assets.

---

## Admin dashboard

| Item | Path |
|------|------|
| Website (XAMPP) | **http://localhost/shaderp/** |
| Source | `tools/shaderp-dashboard/` |
| Sync script | `tools/shaderp-dashboard/Build-DashboardData.ps1` |
| Start local | `Start-Dashboard.ps1 -OpenBrowser` (port 8787) |
| Deploy XAMPP | `Deploy-Xampp.ps1` |

**Panels:** Overview · Updates (v1–v7) · Economy · Map blips + `/gotobiz` · Enabled/disabled resources · Branding registry · Quick commands · Blocked mods

Data pulls from: `shade-config`, `server.cfg`, `HWC_Blips_V2/blips.json`, `UPDATE-LOG.md`

---

## Logo

- File: `resources/[standalone]/shade-config/assets/shaderp-logo.png`
- Copy: `tools/shaderp-dashboard/assets/shaderp-logo.png`
- Use for Discord server icon, loading screen, txAdmin banner

---

**18 June 2026 · Enhancement Pass v7**

---

## Overview

The pyh **job tablet** is back online for ESX. Contacts shop purchases and billing presets were broken or misconfigured — both are fixed.

---

## pyh-tablet ESX enable

| Fix | Detail |
|-----|--------|
| Config | `ESX` + `ox_inventory` |
| Bug | `Config.Framewework` typo prevented `ESX.RegisterUsableItem('tablet')` |
| UX | ox_lib notifications + progress bars |
| server.cfg | **`ensure pyh-tablet`** before pyh-groupsystem |

Tablet apps: Gruppe 6, Trucking, Contacts, Groups, Boosting (chip-gated).

---

## pyh-contacts ESX fixes

| Issue | Fix |
|-------|-----|
| Inventory config | `qb-inventory` → **OX** |
| `payItem` ESX branch | Was empty — now charges cash/bank + adds via ox_inventory |
| Item images/labels | `getImage` / `getLabel` now work on ESX |

---

## codem-billing

- Ambulance/mechanic presets → proper EMS + repair invoices
- Job display names → ShadeRP branding
- Notifications → ox_lib

---

## Restart commands

```
ensure pyh-tablet
restart pyh-tablet
restart pyh-contacts
restart pyh-groupsystem
restart codem-billing
restart ox_inventory
restart shade-config
```

Post Discord update: `tools/Post-ServerUpdate.ps1 -Version v7`

---

**18 June 2026 · Enhancement Pass v6**

---

## Overview

Final branding sweep across job locations, UI labels, and vehicle menus. **pyh-groupsystem** is ported to ESX and re-enabled so Gruppe 6 co-op groups work again.

---

## pyh-groupsystem ESX port

| Change | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Framework | `qb-core` → **ESX Legacy** (`es_extended`) |
| Callbacks | `ESX.RegisterServerCallback` / `ESX.TriggerServerCallback` |
| Notifications | **ox_lib** with ShadeRP title |
| Player names | `xPlayer.getName()` |
| server.cfg | **`ensure pyh-groupsystem`** (before pyh-trucking / gruppe6) |

Gruppe 6 uses `exports["pyh-groupsystem"]:GroupEvent()` — without this resource, group deliveries silently fail.

---

## Branding v6

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `pls_jobsystem/server/jobs.json` | Artex VPD → **ShadeRP LSPD**, NTeam → **ShadeRP Pillbox**, Bennys → **ShadeRP Bennys** |
| `pyh-trucking/shared/config.lua` | Contract names → **ShadeRP City** |
| `shade-config/config/vehicles.lua` | **ShadeRP PD Pack** category |
| `rup-vehiclespawner/config.lua` | Fleet preset key synced |
| `ls-phone/configs/config_client.lua` | WiFi label → **ShadeRP LSPD** |
| `gen_pausev2/config.lua` | Pause map text → Explore **ShadeRP** |
| `wasabi_fishing/configuration/strings.lua` | Blip → **ShadeRP Fish Market** |
| `wasabi_mining/configuration/strings.lua` | Blips → **ShadeRP Mine** / **ShadeRP Mining Sales** |
| `pd-stang/fxmanifest.lua` | **ShadeRP PD Mustang** |
| `shade-config/config/branding.lua` | Added groupsystem, wasabi fishing/mining, pls_jobsystem |

---

## Restart commands

```
ensure pyh-groupsystem
restart pyh-groupsystem
restart pls_jobsystem
restart pyh-trucking
restart pyh-gruppe6job
restart shade-config
restart rup-vehiclespawner
restart gen_pausev2
restart wasabi_fishing
restart wasabi_mining
restart ls-phone
```

Post Discord update: `tools/Post-ServerUpdate.ps1 -Version v6`

---

**18 June 2026 · Enhancement Pass v5**

---

## Overview

This pass balances the economy for long-term RP, wires all major logging into shade-config Discord webhooks, and fills out the city map with ShadeRP-branded blips and admin teleport locations.

---

## Economy (`shade-config/config/economy.lua` + SQL)

| Setting | Before | After |
|---------|--------|-------|
| Starting bank | $50,000 | **$15,000** |
| Starting cash | — | **$750** |
| Paycheck interval | 7 min | **15 min** |
| Off-duty multiplier | 50% | **65%** |
| Unemployed welfare | $200 | **$400** |
| LSPD salaries (grades 0–4) | $20–$100 | **$450–$1,500** |
| EMS salaries | $20–$80 | **$400–$1,200** |
| Mechanic salaries | $12–$48 | **$350–$950** |

**SQL:** `tools/SQL/shaderp-economy-v5.sql` — run against `es_extended`  
**ESX:** `es_extended/shared/config/main.lua` + `logs.lua` (paycheck logging enabled)

---

## Logging (`shade-config/config/logging.lua`)

| System | What it logs | Discord channel |
|--------|----------------|-----------------|
| **ravn-logs** | Join/leave, deaths, PvP, chat, weapons, explosions | server / admin / bans |
| **shade-discord** | Resource starts, `/shadeupdate` | updates |
| **ESX** | Paychecks, `/setjob`, `/car`, money commands | admin |
| **hour-logger** | `/clock-in police\|ems\|mechanic` | admin |

NDJSON file retention: **14 days** (`ravn-logs/logs/`)

---

## City setup

### HWC map blips (15 total)

| # | Location |
|---|----------|
| 1–10 | PD, Pillbox, Bennys, PDM, Pawn, Oil Rig, Bank, Prison, Mall, Track |
| 11–15 | Trucking, Gruppe 6, Lumberjack, Mosley Auto, Power Washing |

Manage in-game: **`/hwcblips`**  
Admin teleport: **`/gotobiz [id]`** (see `shade-config/config/businesses.lua`)

### Branding cleanup

- Removed NTeam / Artex hospital references from businesses + world config
- lb-phone map: **ShadeRP PD** + **ShadeRP Pillbox**
- DB job labels → ShadeRP naming

---

## Restart commands

```
restart shade-config
restart es_extended
restart HWC_Blips_V2
restart ravn-logs
restart lb-phone
restart wasabi_multijob
```

Post Discord update: `tools/Post-ServerUpdate.ps1` (reads `UPDATE-NOTES.txt`)

---

**18 June 2026 · Enhancement Pass v4**

---

## ESX bug fixes

| Script | Fix |
|--------|-----|
| **pyh-boosting** | Contract transfer used hardcoded `QBCore.Functions.GetPlayerByCitizenId` — now framework-aware via `GetPlayerByIdentifier()` |
| **pyh-gruppe6job** | ESX reputation callback called QBCore API (crash) — fixed; `g6cashbag` usable item + progress bar added for ESX |
| **pyh-fishing** | Inventory was `qb-inventory` — set to `OX` for ox_inventory |
| **wasabi_multijob** | Boss menus moved from Artex VPD / NTeam → Mission Row PD + Pillbox coords |
| **jg-mechanic** | Disabled duplicate shop blips (HWC_Blips_V2 handles map) |

---

## Branding v4

- `shade-config/config/branding.lua` — pyh jobs, jg-mechanic, bennys/lsc locations
- HWC blip #3 renamed → **ShadeRP Bennys / LSC**
- pyh job + jg-mechanic manifest descriptions updated to ShadeRP names

**Restart affected resources:**
```
restart shade-config
restart wasabi_multijob
restart pyh-boosting
restart pyh-gruppe6job
restart pyh-fishing
restart jg-mechanic
restart HWC_Blips_V2
```

---

**18 June 2026 · Enhancement Pass v3**

---

## SQL imported (es_extended)

All pending SQL has been run against MariaDB:

| Script | Tables / data |
|--------|----------------|
| shade-airdrops/airdrops.sql | airdrop routes, tiers, settings |
| kq_powerwashing esx_job.sql | `powerwashing` job |

---

## Map blips → HWC_Blips_V2

- Removed shade-config business blip system (`showBlips`, `/biz`, `/addbusiness`, server blip registry)
- **HWC_Blips_V2** deployed — admins use `/hwcblips` to manage blips
